title: The Will of Ashcombe
author: Hazel Oyelaran
blurb: Tamsin Brightwater, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
